طُهْرٌ [see 1: ―
-b2- ] Cleanness; freedom from dirt or filth; or pureness. (S, * Msb.) ―
-b3- The state of pureness from the menstrual discharge: (S, A, Mgh, Msb:) pl. أَطْهَارٌ. (A, Msb.) And the pl. signifies The days of a woman's state of pureness from the menstrual discharge. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
